text:
alex_liu: quick check — I'm about to change the p99 TTFT alert for customer routes (we're seeing noisy spikes). where's the canonical dashboard and recommended slices to baseline?

danielle: try the latency-overview dashboard first, it has p50/p95/p99 panels and tokens/sec breakdown by model and route. link: https://grafana.internal.redwood/d/latency-overview — use var_model & var_route

mike_s: also look at the tokenflow panel (tokens/sec) + request_type tag. spikes often correlate with token/sec drop.

maya: for traces, jump to Jaeger -> service=inference and search by trace.tags.route=<route>. sample link: https://jaeger.internal.redwood/trace/<trace-id> (replace)

alex_liu: thanks. any recommended PromQL to slice p99 by model + customer tier? want a quick query to paste into alert builder.

mike_s: this is what I use (5m window p99):
```
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(redwood_inference_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="inference"}[5m])) by (le, model, route, customer_tier))
```

danielle: for tokens/sec: `sum(rate(redwood_inference_tokens_generated_total[1m])) by (model, route)` and then divide by active_concurrent_requests if you want per-request throughput.

alex_liu: nice. what's the team's opinion on alert noise from warmup and short-lived canaries? i was considering a 5-min for p99 but maybe use 15m for production alerts.

maya: we suppress alerts with `deployment=canary` via alertmanager routing. for prod, 5m is ok for latency regression but add a condition: alert only when sustained for 3 evaluation periods. e.g. eval_interval: 5m, for: 15m.

mike_s: also add a `sum(rate(redwood_inference_requests_total{route=~"/customer/.*"}[5m])) by (route) > 10` as a guard so low-volume routes don't flip.

alex_liu: can someone paste a sample alert rule YAML?

danielle: sure — quick draft:
```yaml
- alert: InferenceTTFTHighP99
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(redwood_inference_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=\"inference\",route=~\"/customer/.*\"}[5m])) by (le, model, route, customer_tier)) > 0.8
  for: 15m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "p99 TTFT > 800ms for {{ $labels.route }} (model={{ $labels.model }})"
    runbook: https://confluence.redwood/internal/obs/runbooks/ttft-p99
```

sre-oncall: nudge — if you change the alert please coordinate with oncall rotation. we got a false page last month from a deployment spike. also add a tag to suppress for `deployment=canary` or `priority=low`.

alex_liu: will do. last q: where are the dashboards with token/sec heatmaps and request size distribution? I want to correlate with client-side batch sizes.

mike_s: dashboards: latency-overview (has heatmap), tokenflow (tokens/sec per model), request-distribution (payload sizes). quick links: https://grafana.internal.redwood/d/tokenflow, https://grafana.internal.redwood/d/request-distribution

danielle: if you want, I can spin up a small Grafana view with the exact panels and a prefilled alert rule so you can iterate.

alex_liu: that would be perfect, thanks danielle. I'll make the alert change in a branch and ping for review. @sre-oncall i'll post the PR once ready. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy started: inference-configs/alerts@pr-483 (alex_liu) — CI checks running

sre-oncall: got it, will watch the PR and hold escalation channel open.

alex_liu: closing loop — I pushed the PR with `for: 15m` + low-volume guard. link: https://git.internal.redwood/inference/infra/compare/pr-483

mike_s: nice. after it's live let's check 24h of p99 and tokens/sec correlation, then consider tightening to 5m if stable.

maya: thanks everyone, good approach.
